how: Korean courses for beginners run at Chuo University's Surugadai Memorial Hall public lectures, at the Tokyo Korean Academy (Mindan) in Shinjuku, and at private schools in Shin-Okubo, several offering free trial lessons.
Institut francais Japon Tokyo (formerly Athenee Francais / Tokyo Nichifutsu Gakuin) in Iidabashi runs group and private French courses from beginner level, with an online level test for newcomers.
Shimamura Music Salon Patria Nishikasai runs a weekly Thursday harp class (Irish and grand harp) with reservable trial lessons for people with no musical experience.
venue: Shimamura Gakki Music Salon Patria Nishikasai

how: The Setagaya SIXES league includes women's and men's general (adult) divisions in 6-a-side lacrosse, while Setagaya clubs such as Magpies run beginner trials for children; a drop-in adult beginner club was not confirmed.

The Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Social Welfare runs a free introductory sign language course (textbook fee only) at a Mita venue, and ward governments such as Ota run beginner to advanced sign language courses for residents.
venue: Tokyo Metropolitan Government sign language course (Mita)

how: Dealers' coin and stamp fairs such as the JSDA Stamp Festival and Sakura Coin Show are held at Nihonbashi Plaza near Tokyo Station, with more shows at Yurakucho; no regular club meeting was found.
venue: JSDA Stamp Festival / Sakura Coin Show (Nihonbashi Plaza)

how: WLS Netball Club, an adult netball club in Tokyo, has advertised trial sessions at an Akasaka community plaza (2012) and was still running netball coaching sessions at a Tokyo school in 2025; current adult training times were not confirmed.
